summary: Shadow traffic quality dashboard shows 'No data' for Dedicated beta tenant (quality deltas missing; latency/cost present)
description:
Customer (Aurora Devtools, Dedicated beta) reports that the Console shows latency/cost deltas for a Shadow Experiment, but Quality Deltas panels show "No data" / "Waiting for scoring" for multiple hours.

Issue summary
- Shadow Experiment running against route: /v1/chat.completions (Dedicated pool)
- Control response returned to users as expected; shadow requests appear in request logs
- Console > Shadow Experiments > Results: latency/cost charts populate; quality charts do not

Impact
- Customer cannot use quality deltas to decide whether to proceed with rollout; blocks their planned model upgrade gate.

Customer-provided details
- Tenant: aurora-prod-dedicated (ID redacted in ticket)
- Experiment: "aurora-qbeta-2026-02" (created ~2026-02-06 09:40 PT)
- Sampling: 5%
- Regions: us-east only
- Time window in UI: "Last 60 minutes" (default)

Expected
- Quality deltas appear within ~10–15 minutes of experiment start (given v1 scoring SLOs).

Actual
- Quality deltas remain empty for >2 hours; no explicit error shown besides "No data".

Notes
- This looks consistent with ingestion/scoring lag rather than request mirroring failure, since shadow request volume is present and control metrics populate.

resolution:
Cause: scoring/ingestion lag in us-east for shadow scoring results (async quality pipeline) due to capacity shortfall and partition hot-spotting; backpressure/circuit breaker prevented overload but increased end-to-end delay, making Console Quality Deltas appear empty for the default 60-minute window.

Fix/mitigation applied
- Scaled scoring workers and scoring-results ingestion consumers in us-east
- Rebalanced partitions / consumer group to reduce hot-spotting
- Monitored until backlog cleared and p95 completion delay returned to <10 minutes

Customer workaround (during incident)
- Expand Console time window to 6h/24h
- Temporarily reduce sampling rate (e.g., 5% -> 1%) until scoring lag clears

Follow-ups
- Improve Console messaging: replace "No data" with "Scoring delayed" + estimated lag when backlog present
- Strengthen alerts for scoring/ingestion lag per shadow traffic SLOs and add beta-specific guardrails on sampling/example capture defaults
